description: GT3 英文/缩写 CMU 单项扰动实验的 ASR 语言固定对照：复用 1,795 条既有扰动音频，将 Qwen3-ASR 请求 language 固定为 en（服务端规范化为 English）。
output_readme:
# GT3 English CMU single-augmentation — fixed-English ASR

Input: the 1,795 single-augmentation WAVs generated by `gt3-english-cmu-cosy-single-augmentations`.

Test: identical audio and decoding settings to the auto-language run, except every ASR request has `language=en`; the managed service normalizes this to `English`.

No pronunciation, TTS, or augmentation is rerun.

ASR: managed WSL Qwen3-ASR, language en / English, temperature 0.65, top_p 1.0, top_k 50, min_p 0.0, seed null.
